name: Known-issues list update
summary: When engineering confirms a fault, your support lead gets the known-issues entry drafted from the cases and the engineering note: affected versions, what customers see in their own words, the workaround exactly as tested, the linked cases. Entries a release says are fixed are flagged. A person approves every change.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of customer support and service work, and its own method for drafting a known-issues entry from an engineering note and linked cases and checking open entries against a release's fixed items, written for this template.
